scripts.dev: npm run build -w @horizon/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @horizon/shared" "npm run dev -w @horizon/api" "npm run dev -w @horizon/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @horizon/shared && concurrently -n shared,api -c magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @horizon/shared" "npm run dev -w @horizon/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @horizon/shared && concurrently -n shared,web -c magenta,green "npm run dev -w @horizon/shared" "npm run dev -w @horizon/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @horizon/shared && npm run build -w @horizon/api && npm run build -w @horizon/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @horizon/shared && npm run build -w @horizon/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @horizon/shared && npm run build -w @horizon/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
